note: Inputs of ephemeris_final.json, copied unchanged from the final re-derivation (2026-10-01) so that the ephemeris can be rebuilt from this deposit (added 2026-10-03; ephemeris_final.json itself is unchanged). build/make_ephemeris.py reads the same numbers from the re-derivation folders, which are not part of this deposit.

A.transit_times_columns: epoch; sector; tc = mid-time in BTJD (BJD_TDB - 2457000); tc_err_formal_min = formal error; tc_err_inj_min = injection-calibrated error (half width of the 16-84 percentile interval of recovered minus injected, 200 injections per transit), used as the weight; the other columns are diagnostics
A.ephemeris_fit: weighted least squares of tc on epoch with weights 1 / (tc_err_inj_min / 1440)^2, all 22 transits, no rescaling; it gives T0, P and cov_T0_P of ephemeris_final.json (to about 1e-9 d, because the CSV rounds the errors to 1e-4 min); sigma_pred(n) = 1440 * sqrt(C00 + 2 n C01 + n^2 C11) min

B.ephemeris_note: joint-fit ephemeris of the internal drafts v1 and v2, unchanged (also in the unpublished draft v1)
B.sigma_rule: sigma_pred_min of ephemeris_final.json = 1.5 x sigma_min_corr (B timing errors are not injection-calibrated)
